Start.Greeting: Hi! I'm Quizr — I run sign-ups for your quiz nights.
Setup.Welcome: Thanks for adding me! I've set the group language to English. Before I can schedule games, a captain needs to set the team's timezone: send /settimezone with an IANA id, e.g. /settimezone Europe/Berlin.
Setup.NotAdmin: I'm not an admin here yet. Please make me one — I need it to pin the board and to see who joins or leaves.
Setup.TimeZoneSet: Timezone set to {TimeZoneId}. Games created from now on will use it.
Setup.TimeZoneInvalid: "{Input}" isn't a timezone I recognise. Use an IANA id, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
NewGame.NeedsTimeZone: This team doesn't have a timezone set yet. A captain should run /settimezone first.
NewGame.NotCaptain: Only a captain can do that.
NewGame.NotBuiltYet: Game creation isn't built yet — it's coming in a later milestone.
Error.Generic: Something went wrong on my end. It's been logged — please try again.
Drop.ConfirmPrompt: Drop out of {Title}? You'll lose your place in the queue — rejoining puts you at the back.
Drop.Cancelled: You're out. Your spot has been given up.
Guest.NamePrompt: Want to give your guest a name? Reply with it, or skip to keep them anonymous.
Guest.Named: Got it — your guest is now down as {Name}.
Guest.KeepQuestion: You're dropping out, but {Name} is named. Should they stay in the game as a team guest?
Guest.Kept: {Name} is staying as a team guest.
MyGuests.Empty: You haven't brought any guests to {Title} yet.
Signup.AlreadySignedUp: You're already signed up for this game.
Signup.NotSignedUp: You don't have a spot in this game.
Signup.NotYourGuest: That's not your guest to manage.
Signup.GuestAlreadyResolved: That guest has already been sorted out.
Signup.RegistrationClosed: Sign-ups for this game are closed.
